_doc: ADR-0083 D-B: the single source of truth for never-commit labels. Task books and capture harnesses reference rule ids (nc-NNN), never freehand paths; a new label requires the registry extension in the same commit (ADR-0027 coupling precedent). Rules are deprecated, never deleted - 'status' carries the lifecycle, 'since' the registration date.

rules.reason: audit evidence trees are examiner work product - verbatim captures stay untracked so the audited surface carries no audit-side residue (task-book convention since grill-t13; audit2-evidence second-window trees included)
round-diff patch files are evidence byproducts of a diff, not records - the commits themselves are the record
per-round commit listings are capture artifacts; they regenerate from git log and must never be committed
task-book labeled reference-asset class: user-side raster references, not pipeline inputs (grill-t23 T4-C-2 - the instance that motivated the registry)
external agent-tool workdirs - generated outside the repo's own pipeline, never part of the tracked surface
gate output directories - isomorphic evidence regenerated per run (ADR-0027 D4)
derived pack artifacts never enter git (grill-t11 audit F-A1, ADR-0073 D-C)
run logs are host-local evidence byproducts; committed evidence lives under .scratch/*/evidence/ in the capture format

host configuration backups never enter git-tracked dirs (ADR-0073 D-C O-2 forward rule); the private/ secrets dir is .gitignore jurisdiction (ADR-0014) and deliberately keeps one tracked fixture, so it stays out of this registry
